# PaintFE v1.4.12

This update improves startup performance, makes larger features optional, and fixes the build problems that prevented v1.4.11 from being published.

## Performance improvements

Settings saves and AI availability checks now run in the background. GPU setup is deferred, and colour sliders reuse cached gradients to reduce drawing work.

## Smaller core download

The CJK font and JPEG XL export encoder are now optional packs under Preferences > Optional features. Download them once or import a downloaded pack, then use them offline.

JPEG XL opening remains built in. Suitable system fonts are used where available, with a font-pack prompt when needed.

## Build fixes

Linux builds now use an explicit Python version. macOS codec tests use the correct pack paths, and the platform-specific Clippy warning is fixed. ZIP and event-listener have been updated, with additional packaging and Linux checks.

## Validation

657 app tests and four packaging-tool tests passed locally. Clippy, formatting, dependency audit and workflow validation passed.

Issues remain open for users to test and confirm.
Further testing is continuing.
